title: Auto farm (needs multiple roblox instances)
features:
8 accounts = 120k credits per round
The amount you gain can be scaled by the amount of alts you use.

The basics on how it works: Main account consistently kills alt accounts that instantly teleport to the main account in secluded area that normal players can't access. You can add as many alts as you want, meaning the gain only increases. It also supports both maps and round endings.

Also provides a few features like optimization, (automatically limiting fps and quality) as well as quality of life features like an anti afk (ofc ofc) and auto disable in game sound.

How to use: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=E13sz0DUxtA

Quick FAQ:
Why is my main not hitting them? Equip baton! Should be auto equipping, will fix any issues with that once i wake up.

It's not working with (krnl, fluxus, etc)? I've successfully used it on some of the free executors, however I cannot guarantee successful execution on all. If you want 100% use synapse.
